system.description:
You infuse chakra into a chakra seal as you attempt to end a jutsu with the seal of resistance.

For this jutsu’s duration, as a bonus action you may select one willing creature within range. That creature gains 2d8 temporary hit points, until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the amount of temporary hit points by 1d8 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
